title: I Stopped Guessing What To Post And Did This Instead
description:
Raw view counts measure the audience. The outlier multiple measures the idea. Divide a post's views by the median views of that same creator's last 20 to 30 posts, and anything at 3x or higher is a real signal, no matter how small the account is.

This breaks down how to find those posts across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and X, how to pull the transcript for free, and how to rebuild the structure in your own voice without copying anyone's sentences. It also covers the exact architecture if you want to automate the whole thing.

Get the full system plus both prompts here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IlGpRfDNzRl6WmgEFP0ekaEV1Q0UVJNV9eAFGACuuq0/edit?usp=sharing
